<subject>Group Meeting Scheduled for 10th May</subject>
<body>
Dear Team,

We will be holding a group meeting on 10th May at 4 PM to discuss tagging, updates to core fundamentals, and team changes. Refreshments, including pizza, will be provided.

I intend to make these meetings a monthly event to keep us aligned with the evolving market and ensure everyone is informed about developments on the floor. If you are unable to attend, have specific topics you would like covered, or have any pizza preferences, please let me know at your earliest convenience.

Best regards,  
James  
Halcyon Mutual Bank  
</body>
